Ingress.fault_plan: Stall or close publication, receipt and lookup peers; reopen real temporary archive storage after missing/corrupt records.
Ingress.recovery_invariants: Exact submit hash, bounded fallback/refusal, no invented receipt, replay resumes from the retained cursor.
Ingress.remaining_real_dependencies: Real archive/media-driver integration and process restart remain required.

Sequencer.fault_plan: Stall intake and lookup replies; disconnect or backpressure orderer output; lose acknowledgements and renew sessions; restart replay from real checkpoints.
Sequencer.recovery_invariants: Preserve sender order and exact bytes, bound queues, recover without new client input, stop cleanly; validator verifies canonical state.
Sequencer.remaining_real_dependencies: Replica racing, process restart, validator checkpoint selection and sustained catch-up are not covered by the first admission fixture.

Cluster.fault_plan: Run real consensus members in a small local group; fail transports or members, vary delay/loss, reopen member storage.
Cluster.recovery_invariants: One leader per term, quorum admission, consistent canonical order, replay/catch-up, and bounded recovery.
Cluster.remaining_real_dependencies: Mocking an elected leader or accepted consensus result cannot validate elections, partition safety or primary replacement; real consensus/network scheduling is required.

Fleet.fault_plan: Stop and restart the affected real actor group; delete only its owned test storage and feed retained checkpoint/log or authoritative upstream data.
Fleet.recovery_invariants: Exact state and receipt parity, complete rebuild coverage before serving, bounded recovery, no stale balance rejection.
Fleet.remaining_real_dependencies: Redis promotion requires real Redis/Sentinel processes; total consensus/storage loss requires real persistence and quorum members.

Coordinated.fault_plan: Fail role boundaries together and restore dependencies in specified order; run the real discovery adapter against a controlled service.
Coordinated.recovery_invariants: Every retained request resolves or fails explicitly; resume with existing senders and no orphaned queues or false readiness.
Coordinated.remaining_real_dependencies: Nomad/Consul rescheduling, network identity and all-node power loss still need deployment checks.

CombinedOrdering.fault_plan: Cut ingress/orderer boundaries in the case order; return peers in dependency order and reverse order; replay retained offers.
CombinedOrdering.recovery_invariants: No lost or reordered sender prefix, no false acknowledgement, no dependency deadlock, exact recovery without new intake.
CombinedOrdering.remaining_real_dependencies: The first sequencer fixture covers boundary assumptions only; real ingress composition and real Raft election closure remain pending.

CombinedExec.fault_plan: Close reader/writer boundaries and remove account sources together; restore state and input in both orders.
CombinedExec.recovery_invariants: Atomic durable boundary, state-root parity, no unsafe sender-floor assumption or balance rejection, bounded fallback.
CombinedExec.remaining_real_dependencies: Requires real MDBX/commit actor and combined read-path fixtures; a mocked commit success is insufficient.

L1.fault_plan: Serve controlled HTTP lies, missing receipts and retained history gaps; resume posting after upstream blackout.
L1.recovery_invariants: Verify headers/receipts, preserve canonical positions, bounded retry, exact contiguous posting and no pruning of needed data.
L1.remaining_real_dependencies: Wall-clock outages can be shortened only with a real clock seam or equivalent boundary-crossing evidence; contracts/retention still need integration checks.

Follower.fault_plan: Run real follower logic against independent controlled HTTP providers; inject timeout/refusal/disagreement and restart one or all actors.
Follower.recovery_invariants: Independent source deadlines and backoff, no false quorum, halt on disagreement and resume after valid replies.
Follower.remaining_real_dependencies: Single-provider mocks do not validate provider quorum or process restart; retain real protocol parsers.

Cache.fault_plan: Inject stale rows, partial writes, absent script, lookup timeout, lost connection and interrupted checkpoint scans; retain real checkpoint state.
Cache.recovery_invariants: Complete coverage before freshness, monotonic account updates, exact receipt identity, bounded executor fallback and rollback-safe rebuild.
Cache.remaining_real_dependencies: Real Lua/Redis transactions and Sentinel promotion need real local services; an in-memory dictionary cannot establish their semantics.

Integrity.fault_plan: Repeat restart sequences against real temporary stores; restore from retained authoritative history; change ownership while traffic is pending.
Integrity.recovery_invariants: Durable state survives restarts, duplicate/replayed data remains idempotent, ownership changes neither lose nor duplicate canonical transactions.
Integrity.remaining_real_dependencies: Unflushed power-loss behavior and full-chain reseeding require real storage and protocol integration.

Carry.fault_plan: Drive actual feature/session/retention transitions while offers and reader requests are held; restart readers and outputs at each boundary.
Carry.recovery_invariants: Correct wire format at each version, retained offers replay safely, exact carry/reference parity and readable retained windows.
Carry.remaining_real_dependencies: The first admission fixture does not validate Java feature activation, deployed rollout order or complete carry/reference parity.

Executor.fault_plan: Run real actors with controlled reader/writer failures and temporary MDBX/checkpoint files; interrupt writes, corrupt images and exhaust the checkpoint device.
Executor.recovery_invariants: No acknowledgement before durable commit, exact replay/state parity, reject corrupt bases, preserve data on failed recovery, remain cancellable.
Executor.remaining_real_dependencies: ENOSPC/EIO and process crash must be real fault effects; node replacement and image rollout remain deployment checks.

Retention.fault_plan: Hold posting or reader cursors beyond actual retention floors, resume requests, and drive halt/canary inputs through real actors.
Retention.recovery_invariants: No pruning of unposted required data, exact contiguous resumed output, correct halt and alert inhibition, no false healthy state.
Retention.remaining_real_dependencies: Mocked cursor values alone do not prove persisted coverage, contracts or alert-routing behavior.

cluster_only_checks: Nomad restarts the task that exits after the client timeout: the restart policy and the container replacement belong to the deployment; the test starts the same binary on the same state as the supervisor
Consul DNS resolves the executor checkpoint peers: the names exist only in the deployed catalog; the test addresses the peer server by IP
Nomad restarts the killed task on its wiped volume: the restart policy belongs to the deployment
